## 0.1 Load data

```{r load_data}
# Gene-topic assignments (from notebook 02_02)
df_gene_assignments <- read_csv(file.path(notebook_out_dir, "02_02_gene-topic-assignment.csv"))

# ASD rare variant statistics
df_asd_rarevar_zscore <- readRDS(file.path(analysis_dir, "00_data_format", "00_01_ASD-rarevar-stats.RDS"))

# GO ID to gene mapping
go_mapping <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys = keys(org.Hs.eg.db, keytype = "ENSEMBL"),
  columns = c("GO", "ONTOLOGY"),
  keytype = "ENSEMBL"
) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    clean_names %>%
    dplyr::rename(go_id = go, ensembl_gene_id = ensembl) %>%
    dplyr::select(-evidence) #%>%

    # # filter pathways by size
    # filter(ontology == "BP") %>%
    # group_by(go_id) %>%
    # mutate(n_genes = n_distinct(ensembl_gene_id)) %>%
    # ungroup() %>%
    # filter(n_genes > 5 & n_genes < 1000)
```


# --- 1) GO cosine similarity hierarchical subclustering --- #

```{r GR_GO_similarity}
# GR ASD gene list (defined in notebook 02_02)
GR_genes <- df_gene_assignments %>%
    filter(GO_topic == "GR") %>%
    pull(gene_name)

# Build GO cosine similarity network (build_go_network defined in code/functions/build_go_network.R)
GR_net <- build_go_network(
    GR_genes,
    go_mapping = go_mapping %>% filter(ontology == "BP"),
    gene_stats = df_asd_rarevar_zscore
)
sim_mat     <- GR_net$sim_mat
genes_no_go <- GR_net$no_go

cat("GO similarity matrix:", nrow(sim_mat), "×", ncol(sim_mat), "\n")
cat("Genes with no GO data:", length(genes_no_go),
    if (length(genes_no_go) > 0) paste0(" (", paste(genes_no_go, collapse = ", "), ")") else "", "\n")
```


# --- 2) Hierarchical clustering of similarity matrix --- #

```{r GR_cluster}
# Ward.D2 hierarchical clustering on GO cosine distance
# Genes not mapped to GO terms are placed by Ward.D2 variance minimization
dist_mat <- as.dist(1 - sim_mat)
hc <- hclust(dist_mat, method = "ward.D2")

n_clusters_GR  <- 10 # starting point, will refine in section 3 
cluster_vec_algo <- cutree(hc, k = n_clusters_GR)

cat("Cluster sizes (k =", n_clusters_GR, "):\n")
print(sort(table(cluster_vec_algo), decreasing = TRUE))
cat("\nNo-GO gene placements:\n")
print(cluster_vec_algo[genes_no_go])
```


# --- 3) Manual overrides --- #

```{r GR_manual_overrides}
# Manually define GR subclusters here so it is clearly defined;
# these subclusters are built off of the output from section 2
manual_cluster_overrides <- tribble(
    ~gene_name,   ~GR_cluster,
    # === 1) Histone & DNA modification: covalent modifiers, erasers, readers ===
    "CREBBP",  1L, "EP300",   1L, "KANSL1",  1L, "MSL2",   1L,  # acetyltransferase complexes
    "KMT2A",   1L, "KMT2C",   1L, "KMT2D",   1L, "KMT2E",  1L,  # H3K4 methyltransferases
    "SETD1A",  1L, "SETD1B",  1L, "ASH1L",   1L, "SETD2",  1L,  # H3K4 / H3K36 methyltransferases
    "NSD1",    1L, "NSD2",    1L, "KMT5B",   1L, "SETD5",  1L,  # H3K36 / H4K20 methyltransferases
    "EHMT1",   1L, "DNMT3A",  1L,                               # H3K9 KMT / DNA methyltransferase
    "KDM5B",   1L, "KDM6B",   1L, "PHF2",    1L,                # histone demethylases
    "JARID2",  1L, "ASXL3",   1L,                               # PRC2 accessory / PR-DUB mark eraser
    "BRD1",    1L, "BRD4",    1L, "MBD5",    1L, "CXXC1",  1L,  # acetyl/methyl readers, CpG binder
    "SIN3A",   1L, "GSE1",    1L, "ANKRD11", 1L, "SETBP1", 1L,  # HDAC scaffolds / modifying-complex cofactors
    # === 2) ATP-dependent chromatin remodelling & genome organization ===
    "SMARCA2", 2L, "SMARCA4", 2L, "SMARCB1", 2L, "ARID1A", 2L, "ARID1B", 2L,  # SWI/SNF (BAF)
    "CHD2",    2L, "CHD7",    2L, "CHD8",    2L,                              # CHD-family ATPases
    "SRCAP",   2L, "EP400",   2L,                                            # SWR1/TIP60 H2A.Z exchange
    "GATAD2B", 2L, "BAZ2A",   2L, "POGZ",    2L, "ADNP",   2L,               # NuRD / NoRC / ChAHP
    "CTCF",    2L, "HIST1H1E",2L, "AHDC1",   2L, "TLK2",   2L,               # genome org / compaction / chromatin assembly
    # === 3) Coactivator & general transcriptional machinery ===
    "TAF4",    3L, "MED13",   3L, "MED13L",  3L, "CDK13",  3L,
    "WAC",     3L, "VEZF1",   3L, "YY1",     3L,
    # === 4) Corepressor & silencing complexes ===
    "SKI",     4L, "TLE3",    4L, "TBL1XR1", 4L, "ZMYM2",  4L, "ZMYND8", 4L,
    "PHF12",   4L, "PHF21A",  4L, "SPEN",    4L, "CIC",    4L, "NACC1",  4L,
    "SLTM",    4L, "RFX7",    4L,
    "ZNF292",  4L, "ZNF644",  4L, "ZNF865",  4L, "ZBTB7A", 4L, "ZBTB34", 4L,  # broad ZNF/ZBTB repressors
    # === 5) RNA processing & post-transcriptional regulation ===
    "HNRNPD",  5L, "HNRNPU",  5L, "SRSF1",   5L, "SON",    5L, "EFTUD2", 5L,
    "SYNCRIP", 5L, "PUF60",   5L, "SCAF1",   5L, "CELF4",  5L,
    "CNOT1",   5L, "CNOT3",   5L, "TNRC6B",  5L, "CAPRIN1",5L, "GIGYF1", 5L,
    "INTS6",   5L, "ZCCHC14", 5L, "EEF1A2",  5L,
    # === 6) Ubiquitin-mediated regulation & protein homeostasis ===
    "CUL3",    6L, "FBXW7",   6L, "FBXW11",  6L, "TRIP12", 6L, "UBR5",   6L,
    "USP7",    6L, "TRAF7",   6L, "TRIM8",   6L, "KBTBD6", 6L, "WDR26",  6L,
    "MAGEL2",  6L, "PSMC5",   6L, "PSMD12",  6L, "RANBP2", 6L, "IRF2BPL",6L,
    "QRICH1",  6L,
    "DHDDS",   6L, "EMC7",    6L, "SPPL3",   6L,                              # protein-biogenesis/homeostasis (ex-SYN)
    # === 7) PI3K-mTOR & growth signalling ===
    "MTOR",    7L, "PTEN",    7L, "TSC2",    7L, "GSK3B",  7L,
    "PTPN11",  7L, "PPP2R5D", 7L, "CSNK2A1", 7L, "DYRK1A", 7L,
    # === 8) Misc / low-annotation (not plotted) ===
    "BCAT1",   8L, "CGREF1",  8L, "DIP2C",   8L, "LEMD3",  8L,
    "PPM1D",   8L, "TOP3B",   8L, "REV3L",   8L, "XPO1",   8L,
    "YLPM1",   8L, "CHAMP1",  8L, "PRR12",   8L
)

# Build cluster_vec directly from the explicit assignment
cluster_vec <- setNames(manual_cluster_overrides$GR_cluster,
                        manual_cluster_overrides$gene_name)

# Check for any GR genes left unassigned
phantom <- setdiff(names(cluster_vec), GR_genes)
if (length(phantom) > 0)
    cat("NOTE: assigned genes not in GR topic:", paste(phantom, collapse = ", "), "\n")
missing <- setdiff(GR_genes, names(cluster_vec))
if (length(missing) > 0)
    cat("NOTE:", length(missing), "GR genes not explicitly assigned:",
        paste(missing, collapse = ", "), "\n")
stopifnot(!any(duplicated(names(cluster_vec))),
          setequal(names(cluster_vec), GR_genes))

# Cluster labels:
# modification → remodeling → 
# coactivator → corepressor/silencing → 
# RNA → ubiquitin → signalling →
# misc. 
# Developmental TFs are found in MORPH
cluster_label_map <- tribble(
    ~GR_cluster, ~cluster_label,                                              ~broad_category,
    1L,          "Histone & DNA modification",                               "chromatin state",
    2L,          "ATP-dependent chromatin remodeling & genome organization", "chromatin state",
    3L,          "Coactivator & general transcriptional machinery",          "Transcriptional control",
    4L,          "Corepressor & silencing complexes",                        "Transcriptional control",
    5L,          "RNA processing & post-transcriptional regulation",         "Post-transcriptional & signaling",
    6L,          "Ubiquitin-mediated regulation & protein homeostasis",      "Post-transcriptional & signaling",
    7L,          "PI3K-mTOR & growth signaling",                             "Post-transcriptional & signaling",
    8L,          "Misc / low-annotation",                                    "Misc"
)

cluster_to_label <- setNames(cluster_label_map$cluster_label,  cluster_label_map$GR_cluster)
cluster_to_broad <- setNames(cluster_label_map$broad_category, cluster_label_map$GR_cluster)

stopifnot(all(cluster_vec %in% cluster_label_map$GR_cluster))

cat("Cluster sizes:\n")
print(sort(table(cluster_vec)))
```


# --- 4) Export subclusters & save graph object for plot --- #

```{r export_objects}
# Export subcluster assignments
GR_cluster_assignments <- tibble(
    gene_name         = names(cluster_vec),
    GR_cluster = cluster_vec,
    cluster_label     = cluster_to_label[as.character(cluster_vec)],
    broad_category    = cluster_to_broad[as.character(cluster_vec)]
) %>%
    arrange(GR_cluster, gene_name)

GR_cluster_assignments %>%
    group_by(broad_category, GR_cluster, cluster_label) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), genes = paste(gene_name, collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(GR_cluster) %>%
    
    write_csv(file.path(notebook_out_dir, "02_03_GR-subcluster-by-GO-similarity.csv"))

# Save graph objects for plot
saveRDS(GR_net, file = file.path(notebook_out_dir, "02_03_GR-GO-similarity-graph.RDS"))
```


# DEPR

## dendrogram

```{r GR_chromatin_dendrogram, fig.height = 10, fig.width = 7.09}
library(dendextend)

# 9 shades of GR orange (#ea801c), from near-white to full colour
GR_color     <- topic_colors[["GR"]]
cluster_pal_9 <- colorRampPalette(c(GR_color, "#fff0d9"))(9)  # darkest = cluster 1, lightest = misc (9)
cluster_colors <- setNames(cluster_pal_9, seq_len(9))

dend <- as.dendrogram(hc)
leaf_colors <- cluster_colors[as.character(cluster_vec[labels(dend)])]
dend <- dend %>%
    set("labels_cex", 0.45) %>%
    set("labels_col", leaf_colors) %>%
    set("branches_lwd", 0.6)

par(mar = c(4, 1, 1, 8))
plot(dend, horiz = TRUE)
abline(v = rev(hc$height)[n_clusters_GR - 1], lty = 2, col = "grey40", lwd = 0.8)
```
